title: e2e Ruffle oracle: motion-tween / motion-guide play static (diffPixels=0) + bitmap renders blank (red=0)
description:
QA sweep at main d8cd458. Three Ruffle VISUAL oracle tests show content rendering but NOT the expected animation/pixels. All reproduced twice (stable, not flake). These are render/runtime-defect candidates (unit tests cannot see them), distinct from the two harness tasks (1214 CWS-parse, 1215 interactivity-autoplay).

(A) apps/desktop/e2e/motion-tween.spec.ts:330 'motion tween plays — object moves from frame 0 to mid-frame'. The SWF loads with autoplay:'on' (helper IS correct here) and the 50x50 red square renders (nonWhiteEarly=2500, nonWhiteMid=2500) but never moves: diffPixels=0 (Expected >50). Fixture: 5-frame scene-timeline classic tween, frame0 keyframe x=50 tweenType:'motion', frames 1-3 NON-keyframe empty displayObjects, frame4 keyframe x=450. The compiler must interpolate the empty in-between frames + emit PlaceObject2 Move tags. Suspect: scene-timeline motion-tween interpolation when in-between frames carry no displayObjects, OR no PlaceObject2/Move emitted. NOTE the contrast: fla-roundtrip.spec.ts:559 'motion tween plays after FLA round-trip' (different doc, SAME harness mechanism) PASSES with diffPixels=7320 — so the harness/timing path works; the standalone fixture's tween does not animate. Confirm by decompressing the CWS body (zlib, bytes 8+) and counting PlaceObject2 tags / inspecting their tx across frames.

(B) apps/desktop/e2e/motion-guide.spec.ts:675 'pixel-position oracle — guided object in correct region at frames 0,2,4 (task 0845)'. Frame 2 (path apex x~300,y~175) — mid-upper region posCount=0 (Expected >50). Guided object not interpolating along the guide path to the apex. (The sibling structural test 530 also fails but that's the CWS-parse harness bug → task 1214; THIS one is a real pixel-position oracle.)

(C) apps/desktop/e2e/bitmap-rendering.spec.ts:202 'bitmap imported to library renders as visible pixels in Ruffle'. A 20x20 solid-red PNG BitmapItem (dataUri) placed at (100,100); Ruffle screenshot has red=0 (Expected >50) — the bitmap is entirely absent. Single static frame so autoplay is not the cause. Suspect: the async bitmap-pixel pre-decode pre-pass in usePublish (decodes dataUri → DefineBits) not completing through the __flashTest.publish() bridge path, yielding an empty/absent bitmap definition; or DefineBitsJPEG/Lossless + PlaceObject for the library bitmap not emitted. Repro: cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/motion-tween.spec.ts e2e/motion-guide.spec.ts e2e/bitmap-rendering.spec.ts (CI env UNSET). Each prints its diffPixels/red counters. Acceptance: all three oracles pass against a fresh run; leave test-results artifacts in place.
